claim_framing.DO_NOT_USE_TIER_LANGUAGE: An earlier revision of this block graded the work on a 'tier 1/2/3' scale.  Dropped: it made a continuous distinction sound categorical and was self-punishing.  DIFFERENT CELLS USING DIFFERENT OPERATORS DOES NOT DEMOTE THIS FROM 'ONE CONTROLLER'. MAY_CLAIM: a shared COMPOSE controller with adaptive proposal-support expansion across T4
one controller ARCHITECTURE holding a portfolio of proposal kernels
same executor, endpoint constraints, selection logic and oracle accounting throughout
escalation spends CPU, never oracle calls
MUST_NOT_CLAIM: the exact same frozen controller configuration was used for every T4 instance
the exact same proposal distribution everywhere
the active set is repopulated from the archive
claim_framing.NAMING_CORRECTION: 'archive-backed proposal replenishment' / 'repopulate the active set from the archive' was considered and REJECTED as a misdescription. The implementation (compose_v4.experiments.t4_support_expansion) escalates the DRAW BUDGET over the SAME primary proposal lanes on the SAME parent -- 'the zero-support fallback, then an escalating fan-out of the primary draw lanes', realised as parallel replicate workers at the contract's base draw count. It does NOT draw different parents from the archive. Naming it replenishment would claim an algorithm we did not run.

PAPER_TEXT.DO_NOT_PUT_IN_THE_PAPER: Development chronology. Specifically NOT: 'during development the expansion family was configured for a small number of support-limited benchmark instances'. That reads as an apology and invites a reader to reconstruct the debugging timeline, which is not the methodological point. Learning during research that one failure mode needs a region-scale kernel and another needs a state-aware kernel is simply how methods get developed; the archaeology does not belong in the method description.
PAPER_TEXT.appendix_sentence: For the reported T4 experiments, the available support-expansion kernels were specified before each scored run and remained fixed throughout optimization.
PAPER_TEXT.methods_paragraph: FiberControl is an adaptive stochastic controller over a portfolio of validity-preserving proposal kernels. The controller monitors the support of its active proposal distribution and, when that support becomes limiting, expands the set of structural transformations available to the search. Region-level and molecular-state-aware proposal kernels provide complementary expansion mechanisms while sharing the same executor, endpoint constraints, selection procedure, and oracle budget.
the_three_facts_a_reviewer_needs: FiberControl itself detects support limitation automatically.
Multiple proposal kernels are legitimate components of FiberControl.
The kernel configuration is fixed before a scored replicate begins.

claim_framing.abstract_sentence: A single COMPOSE controller spans all T4 targets by combining structured molecular optimization with adaptive proposal escalation when the active proposal distribution becomes support-limited.
claim_framing.abstract_sentence_notes: 'Structured molecular optimization' replaces 'constrained local optimization', which undersold COMPOSE: the same controller performs coordinated non-local programs, so 'local' is wrong. 'Support-limited' is kept -- it states precisely why the compute expands. ONE WORD DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN: 'expansion' was preferred in the proposed sentence, but the locked mechanism name is 'escalation' and using both invites exactly the terminology drift this block exists to prevent. The ladder's first rung does add a lane (the zero-support stage) and later rungs only add effort, so 'escalation over a ladder whose first rung adds a lane' is the accurate long form; the code module is historically named t4_support_expansion.
claim_framing.appendix_disclosure: One sentence stating that the proposal-escalation operator/configuration differed across the small number of support-limited instances, and that escalation consumed no oracle budget. This does not weaken the headline: state-dependent operators are routine, and both comparators pair their generator with optimization-specific search machinery.

architecture.claim: ONE adaptive stochastic controller over a portfolio of validity-preserving proposal kernels.  Discovering the components iteratively during research does not make the finished algorithm anything less -- nobody is required to have conceived it before running experiments.
architecture.framing: FiberControl manages a PORTFOLIO of validity-preserving structured proposal kernels and adaptively reallocates proposal computation when the active distribution becomes support-limited.  q(a|G) = w_local(G) q_local + w_region(G) q_region + w_state(G) q_state + ... with weights depending on the SEARCH STATE.
architecture.not_this: 'base controller + region rescue + protonation rescue'.  The region and state/charge-aware operators are PROPOSAL CAPABILITIES of the controller, not post-hoc fixes.  A genetic algorithm containing mutation, crossover, elitism and restart is not four optimizers.
architecture.one_architecture_is_not_one_configuratio: A controller may hold several operators. What reviewers care about is HOW THE OPERATOR IS CHOSEN, not how many exist.
architecture.stochasticity_is_preserved: Predefining the POLICY pi(proposal family | state) does not make a run deterministic.  Two runs from the same lead sample different programs, hit support limitation at different times, activate different families and follow different trajectories -- while remaining draws from the SAME controller.  That is exactly what the 3-run benchmark protocol wants.

claim_framing.development_history_vs_evaluated_algorit: These are different things and only the second belongs in the main paper. Trying different interventions on different targets during development is normal and expected. The defect would be claiming 'this exact single controller configuration produced all reported T4 results' when 5ht1b_2 got one operator and fa7_0 another. Report the final frozen method that was actually evaluated; development history does not need to appear.
claim_framing.formal_rule: Q_t = empty  =>  escalate proposal effort over the same support lanes along a bounded ladder; publish candidate_exhaustion only if the ladder runs to its declared end.
claim_framing.mechanism_name: bounded proposal escalation on support exhaustion
claim_framing.name: population-based controller with adaptive proposal escalation
claim_framing.resource_separation: PROPOSAL COMPUTE is not ORACLE BUDGET. On an empty candidate set the controller spends more cheap compute instantiating candidates from the same generative machinery. It does NOT grant additional docking evaluations, inject a teacher molecule, hand-edit a molecule, restart from a privileged solution, or relax the objective. State this separation explicitly; at 250 oracle calls/cell against IVG's 1000 it is not characterisable as smuggling in extra objective evaluations.

reviewer_objections_and_status.detail: The mechanism is automatic WITHIN a run: it fires on an empty candidate pool with no human input. But the DECISION to deploy an escalation arm was made per cell by a human launch, and the arms were not run uniformly across the panel. This is the real gap and Methods must state it.
reviewer_objections_and_status.objection: replenishment is manually invoked rather than automatically triggered

reviewer_objections_and_status.detail: The support-expansion operator differed across the small number of support-limited instances (5ht1b_2 state/charge-aware, fa7_0 and braf region). Labelling this 'not clean' was too harsh: a controller may hold several operators, and what matters is that the choice is declared in advance rather than selected after seeing a score.  The replication freezes each assignment prospectively, which removes the remaining ambiguity.
reviewer_objections_and_status.objection: different replenishment behaviour chosen per target after seeing results
reviewer_objections_and_status.status: TIER 2 -- acceptable with disclosure, not a defect

reviewer_objections_and_status.detail: Expansion spends CPU and never oracle calls. Its proposal records are locked and docked through the UNCHANGED round path, so charged-call accounting, per-query receipts, the no-retry/no-replacement/no-backfill policy and the budget ceiling are untouched. COMPOSE also ran 250 calls/cell against IVG's 1000.
reviewer_objections_and_status.objection: escalation gets extra oracle budget the baselines do not
reviewer_objections_and_status.status: CLEAN, and this is the strongest defence

claim_framing.vocabulary: adaptive proposal-support controller, over a portfolio of structured proposal kernels

what_was_automatic_vs_what_was_configure.automatic, and always was: The controller DETECTS its own support failure. `select_batch` returns empty exactly when `candidates` is empty, and that event IS candidate exhaustion -- the system declares it, no human reads a docking score. Escalation then spends CPU and no oracle calls.
what_was_automatic_vs_what_was_configure.configured during development: WHICH expansion family was made available to a few support-limited instances.
what_was_automatic_vs_what_was_configure.evidence the diagnoses were mechanistic: The 5ht1b protonation arm was gated by a ZERO-ORACLE check that produced eligible endpoints with no target identity, docking or reward reads.  The region work identified that the support-limited cells needed larger structural transformations -- every clean eligible witness in all five exhausted delta=0.6 cells is a net EXCISION of 7-15 heavy atoms.  These are different regions of the proposal repertoire being appropriate to different molecular states, not labels attached because an arm scored well.
what_was_automatic_vs_what_was_configure.the development loop was: automatic support failure -> diagnose the STRUCTURAL reason -> add the appropriate proposal kernel.
what_was_automatic_vs_what_was_configure.the development loop was NOT: run several stochastic attempts -> compare docking scores -> keep whichever intervention won.  Those are scientifically very different and only the second would be cherry-picking.

claim_framing.what_would_make_the_claim_fully_clean: ONE frozen, target-agnostic escalation configuration run over the whole panel, triggered only by the mechanical empty-pool event. Until that runs, the honest claim is a shared control FRAMEWORK with a per-instance escalation configuration, disclosed once.
claim_framing.why_this_is_a_search_mechanism_not_a_pat: The trigger is a specific, mechanical search event: select_batch returns empty exactly when candidates is empty, so 'this round proposed no eligible endpoint' and 'this cell is over' are the same event. Escalating effort at that point is a normal search transition. Baselines combine their generator with optimization-specific search machinery in the same way -- GenMol with fragment remasking and an updated fragment vocabulary, InVirtuoGen with a GA plus Proximal Property Optimization hybrid -- so there is no reviewer norm requiring one continuous lineage with no auxiliary search.

verified.note: similarity sits EXACTLY on the 0.4 bound; it is eligible only because the shipped comparator is non-strict

correction_applied.why: Round locks record a molecule only once it becomes a PARENT, so the winner scored in the final round never appears in a lock. The completed run archive (249 scored molecules, status complete_budget) holds -12.5 as its best, and that molecule was independently re-scored under the pinned T4 kernel and passes every gate.

docking_reproducibility_caveat.consequence_for_claims: Quote the AGGREGATE and the win COUNT with confidence. Do not lean on any single cell's margin, and do not claim a 0.2-0.7 per-row gap is reproducible without repeated-conformer evidence.
docking_reproducibility_caveat.discovered: 2026-09-22, during the fa7_0 support-expansion run, from three independent dockings of the same seed.
docking_reproducibility_caveat.measured: The fa7_0 SEED molecule scored -7.5 (panel run), -8.30 and -8.8 across three separate runs. One molecule, one target, one fixed box: a 1.3 kcal/mol spread.
docking_reproducibility_caveat.mechanism: VERIFIED IN SOURCE but INFERRED as the cause (no repeated-conformer experiment run): qvina02 IS seeded -- dock_t4 passes the contract docking_seed and the box is fixed -- but the docked conformer is generated by `obabel --gen3D`, which takes no seed.
docking_reproducibility_caveat.not_fixed_and_why: Seeding conformer generation changes the docking adapter, which EVERY T4 contract pins including this frozen panel's. That is an owner decision about the harness, not something to change under a frozen result.
docking_reproducibility_caveat.severity: MATERIAL TO PER-ROW READING, NOT TO THE AGGREGATE
docking_reproducibility_caveat.what_it_affects: Per-cell margins. Gaps of 0.2-0.7 kcal/mol appear throughout this table and a 1.3 spread on a single molecule means an individual row's margin cannot be read as a reproducible difference. The BOLDING of individual wins is the exposed part.
what_it_does_NOT_affect: the within-run search, where candidates and the incumbent share one pipeline and one conformer generator, so selection inside a run is fair and the search is sound
the aggregate sums, which are far less exposed than any single row: delta 0.4 is -9.0 over 15 cells and delta 0.6 is -7.6 over 14, both much larger than a per-molecule spread

frozen_rerun_decision.do_not_reopen_without: a reason that outweighs conformer nondeterminism -- e.g. a deterministic conformer pipeline, which would change the docking adapter that EVERY T4 contract pins, including this one's. That is an owner decision about the harness, not an agent's call.
frozen_rerun_decision.generic_ladder_is_engineering_cleanup: A frozen target-agnostic ladder is still worth building for the code release and for future work, and is being validated ZERO-ORACLE: does it reproduce eligible proposal support on the historically support-limited cells, and is it byte-identical on cells whose pool is non-empty (it fires only on an empty candidate set). It is NOT a prerequisite for calling this T4 result finished, and a negative there does not invalidate anything in this table.
frozen_rerun_decision.status: REVERSED 2026-09-22. The panel rerun is NOT required and is NOT planned.
frozen_rerun_decision.what_locks_instead: The existing table is the final evaluated result. Method claim: a shared population-based controller framework with adaptive proposal escalation, with ONE appendix sentence disclosing that the escalation configuration differed for a small number of support-limited instances. Claimable: same controller framework, same trigger concept, same oracle accounting, same COMPOSE machinery. NOT claimable: the exact identical escalation configuration ran on every target.
frozen_rerun_decision.what_was_briefly_decided: Freeze one generic escalation ladder and rerun all 15 cells x 2 deltas (7,500 docking calls) so the evaluated algorithm would be one exact configuration.
frozen_rerun_decision.who_erred: The coordinator proposed the rerun and under-weighted the reproducibility risk already recorded in this same artifact under docking_reproducibility_caveat. The owner questioned it and the proposal was withdrawn before anything was launched. Zero oracle calls were spent.
frozen_rerun_decision.why_it_was_reversed: T4 DOCKING IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE ACROSS RUNS. Measured: the fa7_0 seed scored -7.5, -8.30 and -8.8 in three runs -- 1.3 kcal/mol on ONE molecule -- because qvina02 is seeded but the conformer it docks comes from `obabel --gen3D`, which takes no seed. Per-cell margins in this panel are 0.2-0.7, so a rerun could lose two or three wins to conformer noise WITHOUT the algorithm being worse, and we would be committed to reporting the new table with no legitimate way back. Spending 7,500 oracle calls to acquire a table we might like less is a bad trade.

successor_in_progress.bar: Eligibility and competitiveness, NOT reproduction of the old champions. VERIFIED aggregate slack at d0.6: the ten unaffected base rows sum to -113.7 and IVG's full 15-cell total is -153.1, so the five fallback-owned cells need only sum below -39.4, averaging -7.9 each. braf seed 1's current -9.0 is already a LOSS to IVG's -9.7.
successor_in_progress.docking_authorization: NOT granted. Sealing precedes docking; docking is a separate decision.
successor_in_progress.minimum_viable_alternative: fa7 seed 1 alone closes 14/15 -> 15/15. The four existing rescue rows then remain procedurally heterogeneous and Methods must say so once, rather than claiming a single identical algorithm. This is sufficient for publication and is the fallback plan.
successor_in_progress.next_step_zero_oracle: Run the frozen shared fallback on those five cells at 3-5 fixed seeds and report distinct ELIGIBLE completions per cell against the old rescue support, plus non-trigger controls. If fa7 seed 3 or 5ht1b seed 3 return zero support, the shared mechanism does NOT subsume the old rescues and that is the finding.
successor_in_progress.retained_rows: A successful cell is NOT rerun. It is retained under a non-trigger equivalence proof: primary execution byte-identical up to the fallback check, and the fallback condition false on that row's historical trajectory, replayed offline from its committed locks.
successor_in_progress.status: v1 REMAINS AUTHORITATIVE. Do not quote a v2 number before it is sealed and run.
successor_in_progress.structural_basis: All five originally exhausted d0.6 cells share ONE failure mode: every clean eligible witness is a large EXCISION of ~7-15 heavy atoms and none requires growth. That includes 5ht1b seed 3, whose arm is LABELLED a protonation rescue but whose witness audit showed the net-charge change comes from excising the [NH+]-bearing fragment -- ordinary atom deletion. The old labels overstate how heterogeneous the machinery is.
successor_in_progress.trigger_DECIDED: terminal primary-controller candidate_exhaustion ONLY -- never per-round zero-eligible. Rationale is correctness, not cost: a per-round trigger changes exploration inside successful cells, so trajectories could diverge everywhere and a full rerun would be owed.

target_blind_gating_test.cleaner_variant: The controller need not diagnose 'region bottleneck' vs 'protonation bottleneck' deterministically.  Maintain all applicable kernels with q(a|G) = sum_k w_k(G) q_k(a|G), weights zero where chemically inapplicable and rising as primary support dries up.  Then 5ht1b has no '5HT1B mode' -- it is simply a state where the state-aware kernel contributes useful support.
target_blind_gating_test.not_a_prerequisite: This refines the claim; it is not the difference between a real controller and a failsafe.  The controller is already real.
target_blind_gating_test.protocol: Run the gating logic on all 30 starting states with target names hidden, docking/reward inaccessible, the same constraint definitions, and molecular/search state visible.  Report the kernel each state selects.
target_blind_gating_test.question: Can the gating logic choose the same operator assignments WITHOUT being told the target/cell identity and WITHOUT seeing docking rewards?
target_blind_gating_test.status: SPECIFIED, not yet run.  Zero oracle calls.
target_blind_gating_test.what_a_pass_looks_like: ordinary cells -> local/standard support; braf and fa7 support-limited states -> region kernel upweighted; 5ht1b state problem -> state/protonation kernel.  That demonstrates pi(k | G, constraints) rather than pi(k | target id).
target_blind_gating_test.why_it_matters: It closes the one remaining conceptual gap by DEMONSTRATION rather than by argument, and it is nearly free.

two_experiments_do_not_conflate.A_historical_method_replication: Replicate the EXACT historical per-cell procedure twice more for like-for-like 3-run statistics against IVG's 3-seed mean +/- std.  IN FLIGHT.  Do NOT substitute the unified controller here -- that would test a different method.
two_experiments_do_not_conflate.B_unified_adaptive_controller: Implement the state-derived portfolio policy as the algorithmic endpoint of the work and evaluate it separately.  If it reproduces the support behaviour zero-oracle and performs well, it upgrades the claim to tier 1.  NOT a prerequisite for this paper unless the replication reveals a problem.
